page_title: STR 4-2 LYO | Strasbourg v Lyon 28/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' 4 - 2 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Djordje Petrovic no chance!
90+6' Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90+5' Mamadou Sarr (Strasbourg) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Romain Lissorgue saw the whole situation. Lyon are about to take a penalty!
90+4' Lyon take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+4' Substitution. Sekou Mara (Strasbourg) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Emanuel Emegha walks off.
90+4' Liam Rosenior prepares a substitution. Valentin Barco is replaced by Abakar Sylla (Strasbourg).

90+2' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Djordje Petrovic pulls off an easy save.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' The substitution has been made. Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) has replaced Dilane Bakwa.
89' 4 - 1 Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg) gets on the end of a pass inside the box and fires into the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
87' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Lyon was in an offside position.
85' Paulo Fonseca has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nemanja Matic (Lyon) replacing Tanner Tessmann.
85' The referee signals a substitution. Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) is brought on as a substitute for Abner Vinicius.
85' Wasted opportunity! Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar.
83' Romain Lissorgue shows a yellow card to Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) for his blatant foul.
82' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
82' The referee is firm and issues Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) a deserved yellow card.
80' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Romain Lissorgue no option but to blow his whistle.
79' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Romain Lissorgue blows for a foul.
78' Paulo Fonseca has decided to substitute Ernest Nuamah and he is replaced by Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon).
77' Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) makes contact with a cross but fails to connect perfectly. The ball heads right towards the middle of the goal where the goalkeeper makes a decent save to deny him.
76' Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) climbs high to connect with a cross on the edge of the box, but his header is off-target.
73' 3 - 1 Goal Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg)! Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) was put through by Valentin Barco and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom right corner. 3:1.

71' Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Lucas Perri pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
70' Paulo Fonseca decides to make a substitution. Jordan Veretout will be replaced by Thiago Almada (Lyon).
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg) is coming onto the pitch as Sebastian Nanasi cannot continue after picking up an injury.
69' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
68' Guela Doue (Strasbourg) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. Corner kick. Strasbourg will have an opportunity.
68' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

68' A snap shot by Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) from the edge of the area flies towards the roof of the net, but Lucas Perri produces a good save to thwart him. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Strasbourg.
66' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
64' The resulting corner from Rayan Cherki (Lyon) is cleared.
64' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Rayan Cherki (Lyon) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The ball is out of play and Lyon manage to earn a corner.
62' 2 - 1 Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) gets to a rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball into the middle of the goal, and thus alter the score to 2:1.
62' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the middle of the goal. However, Djordje Petrovic anticipates the shot and makes a decent save.

60' 2 - 0 Goal! Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom left corner. Lucas Perri had no chance of reaching it. The score is 2:0.
58' Clinton Mata (Lyon) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Romain Lissorgue has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

55' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) gets on the scoresheet after converting a chance from the resulting corner kick. He finds himself some space inside the box and plants a perfect header down inside the left post. 1:0.
54' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) will deliver the corner kick.
54' A quickly taken corner by Strasbourg.
53' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) takes the corner which is cleared.
53' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) fires the ball from distance, but it's blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Strasbourg will have a chance to score from a corner.
53' Strasbourg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

52' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top right corner only for Lucas Perri to dive and make a save. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Strasbourg.
51' Romain Lissorgue blows for a foul after Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. A free kick is awarded to Strasbourg.
49' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
48' Jordan Veretout (Lyon) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+1' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
43' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
42' The ball possession is 38:62.
40' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) has a goal ruled out for offside!
39' Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) picks up a sweet pass and fires one in from distance low towards the middle of the goal, but Djordje Petrovic is alert and makes a decent save.
38' Dangerous play by Corentin Tolisso (Lyon). Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle for a foul.
36' Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Djordje Petrovic intercepts the ball.
34' Jordan Veretout (Lyon) rises high to meet a perfect cross, but luckily for the goalkeeper he steers his header just over the crossbar.
31' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) stands over the resultant free kick from mid-range, but his shot goes just over the crossbar. It could have been a fantastic goal!
30' Abner Vinicius (Lyon) makes a slide tackle, but referee Romain Lissorgue blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Strasbourg.
28' What a chance that is! Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post.
27' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Rayan Cherki (Lyon). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

26' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The referee blows his whistle, Lyon are awarded a corner kick.
26' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
25' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Lyon will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
24' Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle. Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) commits a foul after dangerous play.
23' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal and forces the goalkeeper to make a great save.

22' A sweet pass finds Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball low towards the middle of the goal. Djordje Petrovic is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
21' Romain Lissorgue couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Guela Doue (Strasbourg) and blew his whistle.
21' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) commits a rough challenge and Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle for a foul.
19' Lyon are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
17' The referee blows his whistle as Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) was too aggressive in his challenge.
16' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.

15' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Djordje Petrovic makes a great save to stop his effort.
12' The Lyon players are exchanging some short passes.
10' Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) wastes a huge chance as he sends a first-time shot from the goal area straight onto the crossbar!

9' Jordan Veretout (Lyon) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Djordje Petrovic leaps like a salmon to deny him.
8' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
7' Rough tackle by Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
7' Strasbourg produce a short pass from the free kick.
6' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Moussa Niakhate (Lyon). Romain Lissorgue saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Strasbourg have a free kick.
4' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
2' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) takes the corner but it's cleared.
2' Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Djordje Petrovic, who smothers the ball. Lyon get a corner.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Lyon will have the kick-off.
Romain Lissorgue was nominated as the referee for this game.
